ui.placeHint: Grab the tip of the dim vector and move it to where the turn will take it, or point at a marker. Then press Lock in.
ui.positionHint: Point at a marker on the sphere and pull the trigger.
ui.gateHint: Press the button to apply the turn.
ui.timeoutHint: Time to apply the turn. Press the button.
ui.rotateHint: Watch the turn. The dim vector is your prediction.

placement.prompt: Where will the vector point after a quarter turn toward |1⟩? Place the dim vector there.
placement.correct: Right place: a quarter turn reaches the equator.
placement.noPlacement: A quarter turn took the vector to the equator.
placement.genericIncorrect: A quarter turn takes the vector to the equator.

misconceptions.text: The turn moves the vector down to the equator.
A quarter turn stops at the equator; |1⟩ takes a half turn.

tasks.prompt: After a quarter turn toward |1⟩, how often will a measurement give 0?
tasks.correct: Yes, 50%: on the equator, 0 and 1 are equally likely.
tasks.noPrediction: 50%: on the equator, 0 and 1 are equally likely.
tasks.genericIncorrect: It is 50%: on the equator, 0 and 1 are equally likely.

misconceptions.text: It is 50%: the turn moved the vector to the equator.
It is 50%: a quarter turn stops at the equator, not |1⟩.

placement.prompt: Where will the vector point after S, a quarter turn about z? Place the dim vector there.
placement.correct: Right place: S turns |+i⟩ a quarter turn on, to |−⟩.
placement.noPlacement: S turned the vector a quarter turn on, from |+i⟩ to |−⟩.
placement.genericIncorrect: S turns |+i⟩ a quarter turn around the equator, to |−⟩.

misconceptions.text: Right-hand rule: S turns |+i⟩ on to |−⟩, not back to |+⟩.
S is a quarter turn, so |+i⟩ goes to |−⟩, not |−i⟩.
A turn about z never changes the height; it ends at |−⟩.
|+i⟩ is on the equator, so a turn about z moves it, to |−⟩.

tasks.prompt: After S, how often will a measurement give 0?
tasks.correct: Yes, 50%: S keeps the vector on the equator.
tasks.noPrediction: 50%: S keeps the vector on the equator.
tasks.genericIncorrect: It is 50%: S keeps the vector on the equator.

misconceptions.text: It is 50%: a turn about z never changes the height.

placement.prompt: Where will the vector point after H? Place the dim vector there.
placement.correct: Right place: after the Z, H sends |−⟩ to |1⟩.
placement.noPlacement: After the Z, H sent |−⟩ to |1⟩, not back to |0⟩.
placement.genericIncorrect: H swaps |−⟩ and |1⟩, so it ends at |1⟩.

misconceptions.text: H undoes H only with nothing between; after the Z, it gives |1⟩.
H does not undo Z; it takes |−⟩ to |1⟩.
|−⟩ is not on H's axis, so H moves it, to |1⟩.

tasks.prompt: After H, how often will a measurement give 0?
tasks.genericIncorrect: It is 0%: at |1⟩, every measurement gives 1.

misconceptions.text: It is 0%: after the Z, H gives |1⟩, not |0⟩.
It is 0%: here H gives |1⟩, not a superposition.

placement.prompt: Where will the vector point after a 60° turn toward |1⟩? Place the dim vector there.
placement.correct: Right place: 60° stops above the equator.

misconceptions.text: The turn tips it down from |0⟩.
Too far: the equator is 90°.
Too far: |1⟩ is 180°.

tasks.prompt: After a 60° turn toward |1⟩, how often will a measurement give 0?

misconceptions.text: 75%: only the equator is 50/50.
75%: chance follows height, not angle.
75%: any tilt gives some 1s.
